title: AI Transformation Expert
description: We need an expert to lead a company-wide AI transformation using OpenAI Codex and AI automation. The role includes assessing current workflows, identifying automation opportunities, designing implementation plans, and supporting execution across departments. You will collaborate with leadership to align AI initiatives with business goals, improve efficiency, and drive measurable results. Experience with large-scale AI adoption and cross-functional coordination is essential.
